notes.title: Patch Notes | Last Resort v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

First, we would like to thank everyone who provided us with feedback over the last week. We've been working on a small patch that will address some of the issues you pointed out. Below is a list of all the additions, changes & fixes made to the game. Try it out, and let us know what you think!

Cheers,
Thomas from Team SoupVision

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added reload audio for the shotgun & assault rifle.
[*] Added boss voice line for club level completion.
[*] Added pistol ADS on-screen position.
[*] Added pistol 3rd-person ADS pose.
[*] Added red dot sights and medium-range upgrades for all weapons. 
[*] Added reload animations for the Assault Rifle. 
[*] Added set dressing to some empty parts of the level. 
[*] Added pistol reload sound. 
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*] Balancing changes to upgrade drop rarity: epic and rare upgrades are now less common. 
[*] General balancing changes to upgrades. 
[*] Lowered interaction distance with facilities from 500 to 300. 
[*] Changes to pest leap behavior, pests now no longer stand still after leaping. 
[*] General UI improvements. 
[*] Removed superficial menus. 
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Quick Eject Magazine for the pistol now no longer makes the pistol consume ammunition. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the quick eject magazine upgrade for the pistol made it consume ammunition.
[*] Fixed an issue where the quick eject magazine upgrade for the pistol reloaded 1 ammunition at a time. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the quick swap magazine upgrade for the assault rifle prevented players from equipping the assault rifle. 
[*] Player health bars are no longer the same length as their username. 
[*] Quick Eject Mag no longer reloads 1 ammo at a time.
[*] Removed unused meshes. 
[*] Fixed interaction range with vending machines. 
[*] Fixed mouse sensitivity issue.
[/list]
